fields.name: 𓆉 Support Roles
fields.value:
🏗️ - Class Builder: Guild Member who is experienced with class builds and is ready to help others when pinged
👷 - Crafter: Guild Member with their professions levelled up who can craft items on request when pinged
🐚 - Ingredient Grinder: Guild members who wants to help out with gathering ingredients and/or wants to be pinged when shell rates are updated.

fields.name: 𓆉 Pronoun Roles
fields.value:
👨 - Merman: For people that want to be referred to as he/him.
👩 - Mermaid: For people that want to be referred to as she/her.
👻 - Ghost Fish: For people that want to be referred to as they/them. ‎

fields.name: 𓆉 Timezone Roles
fields.value:
🌎 - America: Members that primarily play in American (NA/SA) timezones.
🌍 - Europe/Africa: Members that primarily play in European/African timezones.
🌏 - Asia/Oceania: Members that primarily play in Asian/Oceanian timezones.

fields.name: 𓆉 Event roles
fields.value:
🎉 - Events: Role to be pinged when our guild organizes events.
🎁 - Giveaways: Role to be pinged when giveaways are happening in the ⁠giveaways channel.
:japanese_ogre: - Annihilation: Get pinged when Annihilation party is happening
